focused_validation.scope: Final context privacy races plus compaction unit tests

proven: Both voice routes preserve the actual capture source; the orchestrated user and assistant turns use the same capture/conversation UUIDs and capture timestamp as short-term memory
Raw context projections exclude a capture at its original expiry boundary: text prompt, chat, recent entities, history and serialization
Compaction and recompaction retain all contributing sources; summary and entity hints expire at the earliest source deadline, without snapshot, access or rehydration renewal
Legacy context files remain unchanged outside policy_v2; a fresh last_seen field cannot make an unsourced summary usable
Late compaction cannot restore context after expiry, clearing, replacement or a committed conversation revocation
Final compaction preserves a context reactivated during its await, including when the wall clock repeats; activity and privacy use separate revisions
File commit under the source transaction precedes a concurrent tombstone; queued writes starting after a tombstone are rejected, and committed older files are no longer readable
A fresh FactLedger instance loads committed revocations; context maintenance purges the revoked policy snapshot
Known expired or revoked snapshots are purged at startup/maintenance; uncommitted temporary files left by failed atomic replacement and failed unlink are retried by cleanup
Snapshot files use mode 0600 and the new policy directory uses private creation permissions
Disk hydration releases the context lock, remains tracked after caller cancellation and does not block an unrelated in-memory context read
Standalone context workers remain owned after cancellation and close waits for their actual exit; the runtime uses the shared bounded memory worker scope
An already loaded context requires no new native slot even with all eight memory workers occupied
A committed conversation revocation also removes raw short-term text from prompts; the next direct capture starts a fresh interaction scope
The source-free compiled CPython 3.13 artifact exercises context snapshot save, read-time expiry, failed rehydration of expired text and actual file purge
limits_and_remaining: H3 remains incomplete; no deployment, restart, HA action or migration of actual private data was performed
This is not yet a dashboard-authorized conversation erasure across raw captures, clips, facts, all context copies and pending jobs; there is no HTTP endpoint claiming that completed scope
Event logs, collectors, queued/completed request DTOs, last-response state, other caches and alternate persistence routes still need provenance and raw text/audio retention integration

Known policy snapshots use earliest-source expiry; legacy snapshots are not hydrated or modified, and actual legacy migration still needs a private-copy rehearsal with compatible data/runtime rollback
Tombstone reads use the initialized sole policy writer cache; file commits use its SQLite transaction. No support is claimed for independently mutating the private catalogue outside that writer
The embedded Chroma lifetime and full runtime cleanup/resource acceptance, including the older no-persister cleanup thread path, remain H4/H6 work
Ambient pause, total mute with non-audio reactivation, fingerprint/group expiry, manually confirmed voice profiles, grouping/review UI and calibrated acoustic evaluation remain pending
H0 live inventory/effects evidence and H2 hardware/full-runtime latency acceptance remain open, as do H4, H5 and H6
